fields.name: vehicle_assignment_id
fields.description: The identifier associated with the vehicle or consist in the operational data. For a single vehicle (type=vehicle), this is typically the same as vehicles.vehicle_id. For a consist (type=consist), this is a unique identifier assigned when the consist is formed; a consist that is broken up and re-formed should receive a new identifier. This identifier is not required to match GTFS-realtime VehicleDescriptor values, though it may where operational systems use the same identifiers.

fields.name: service_date
fields.description: Service date of the assignment. Optional; assignment_start_time and assignment_end_time may be used to bound assignments that span multiple days or change within a day.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Indicates whether the assignment refers to a vehicle or a consist.

fields.name: vehicle_id
fields.title: ID referencing vehicles.vehicle_id
fields.description: Identifies the physical vehicle for this assignment. Required when type=vehicle; omitted when type=consist (the cars of a consist are documented in consist_vehicles).

fields.name: vehicle_group_id
fields.title: ID referencing vehicle_groups.vehicle_group_id
fields.description: Identifies the vehicle group whose attributes apply to this assignment. For a single vehicle, this matches vehicles.vehicle_group_id; for a consist, this references the group describing the consist type.

fields.name: assignment_start_time
fields.description: The timestamp when the assignment starts.

fields.name: assignment_end_time
fields.description: The timestamp when the assignment ends.

fields.name: operational_status
fields.description: Indicates the status of the vehicle on this date.

name: vehicle_assignments.schema.json
description: Vehicles and consists available for assignment to service, to which operational data and devices may be associated. Optional table: agencies with static fleets and no consists or vehicle status tracking may omit it. A single-car train is represented by two records: one for the physical vehicle and one for the consist.
